# THE 1ˢᵗ SCI-FI NARRATIVE FILM in the NEW IMMERSIVE CINEMA FORMAT (8K 180VR-3D)
 .


**The Talent Stealer™ is an Award-Winning & Spectacular Sci-Fi Action-Thriller that achieves NEW LEVELS of Entertainment and Sophistication in VR Filmmaking - with an incredible concept & story in the vein of The Matrix, Inception, X-Men and Nikita:**
![{"height":242,"type":"image","width":1280}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75429290_832273112164063_748836112433419211_n.png?_nc_cat=103&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=Kx--pQl-m1kQ7kNvgFQ6vNv&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCSFwTD0LUc4ddeX4jPTQYePaI3fvd1wqnLFFFtiEhiQg&oe=6749928F)

.

At a secret facility called The Maxstein Institute, a group of students are controlled and trained to master their special memory & skill-stealing abilities by a shadowy organization with morally ambiguous goals. One student is singled out for her extraordinary power, and finds herself in a fight for her freedom and sanity from those that wish to control her

**Starring performers Breanna Watkins (The Predator, Sonic) and Jared Payne (The Last of Us Se2)**

.
![{"height":524,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75210397_568206855684714_6818633671153681412_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=-XWqrSXMqhEQ7kNvgGyLiys&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAidX6lmS09f2osfJHwQsb_YtWBw1icnDHCe_339RbPew&oe=6749B4BD)
![{"height":1063,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38984459_428947986916423_4436878377542760621_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=7YPVPw0zaRAQ7kNvgGeEiMZ&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYD3JOVA3LY3lvDSSmDm-tCeKWdyoPneymtkLRNt8L0eJg&oe=67499E50)






- Specially engineered to combine elements of 2D Cinema with the new 3D-180 Immersive Video format, you can truly feel like you have "stepped inside" a Hollywood movie for the **VERY FIRST TIME** - experiencing Cinema standards of lighting, music, VFX and editing for a complex narrative story flow and "little to no" motion sickness

![{"height":876,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974611_594527466344720_2836532959529751053_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=F_yxEr2I5JYQ7kNvgEpu2JP&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYByQe_yolOxZMClAwHkQ74wQ40zZPKVJ7jLcaid1KWZmQ&oe=67499BBC)

**The Talent Stealer™  (30min) is the first Chapter in a series of Chapters coming soon (further TRAILER included!)**



*SPATIAL AUDIO upgrade soon
*Film contains scenes with flashing lights and not suitable for photosensitive viewers
